column1: # [E2E-42/P0] SECTION 2 -- SOURCE OPTION WORDS vs AST OPTION KEYS, one row per measured OPEN
# The SOURCE column masks the FILE operand: `open file(input)' SPELLS the word input without
# carrying the INPUT option.  That masking is the [C287] correction to OPEN-MATRIX.tsv's own
# OUTPUT/INPUT columns.  The AST column is every io_opt key pli80tree.exe prints, minus FILE,
program   line     source option words             AST keys (minus FILE)           verdict
TOTAL 33/34 -- the AST option-key sequence equals the source option-word sequence for every
one of the 34 measured OPEN statements.  Order is preserved; duplicates are preserved (two
TITLEs arrive as two io_opt entries); and a nested operand stays INSIDE its option --
The MISMATCH rows an earlier draft of this audit produced were its own regex matching a
nested CALL's function name as an option word, not a compiler fault.
